verdict.rationale: Genie lets business users ask natural-language data questions through the Genie One interface and get answers grounded in organizational data, returned as SQL, results tables and visualizations. Unity Catalog enforces access control beneath every data interaction, and metric views provide a semantic layer where metrics are defined once and the engine generates the correct computation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Genie answers use metric views or semantic definitions to avoid ad-hoc joins, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer accuracy.
